DILG BAGONG PIUP'NAS Republic of the Philippines DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT DILG-NAPOLCOM Center, EDSA cor. Quezon Avenue, West Triangle, Quezon City www.dilg.gov.ph OPINION NO. S. JUL 312025 SALVADOR P. ANTOJADO JR. Mayor Municipality of Kalawit Zamboanga Del Norte Dear Mayor Antojado Jr.: This refers to your letter dated April II, 2025, seeking this Department's legal opinion on whether the Vice Mayor may sign the certification on budget limitation for appointments, pursuant to Section 325(a) of Republic Act No. 7160 or the Local Govemment Code of 1991 (LGC). Section 325(a) of the LGC limits appropriations for personal services to 45% or 55% Of the LGU's regular income from the preceding year, depending on income classification. Compliance with this ceiling is verified through certifications issued by the local budget officer, accountant, and treasurer. These officers are designated under the LGC to ensure that appointments do not exceed budgetary limits. As a general rule, appointments funded from the municipal appropriations fall under the Mayor's authority and must be supported by certifications from the LGU's fiscal officers. The Vice Mayor, therefore, has no authority to issue or sign the budget limitation certification for such appointments. However, pursuant to Atienza v. Villarosa (G.R. No. 152318, March 2, 2007) and DILG Legal Opinion No. 25, s. 2016, the Vice Mayor retains authority to appoint employees whose compensation is charged to the Sanggunian's own appropriations, such as staff of the Sangguniang Bayan and the Office of the Vice Mayor. In such cases, certifications on fund availability for personal services should still come from the LGU's fiscal officers, not from the Vice Mayor. In summary, the Vice Mayor may appoint Sanggunian-funded staff but is not authorized to sign certifications on budget limitation under Section 325(a). This function is reserved for the designated fiscal officers of the LGU. This opinion is rendered based on the facts provided and without prejudice to any contrary interpretation by competent authorities or the courts. We hope to have clarified the matter. Very truly yours, "Matino, Mahusay at Maaasahan" Trunkline No.: 8876-34-54

BY XUTHOR\TY OF THE SECRETARY: ATTY. ROMEO P. BENITEZ Undersecretary for External, Legal and Legislative Affairs OUSELLNRPB/LLLS-LLRALD/mag Page 2 of2
